desc_enabled: Short sounds while a reply comes in, with one tone for speech and another for actions.
desc_default_voice: Used by every character that has no voice of its own.
desc_narration: Text outside quotes and asterisks gets a soft neutral tone. Off, it stays silent.
hint_per_char: Each character can have a voice of its own: open the character editor and look for "Blip voice". A reply the automatic TTS is going to read has no blips.
editor_hint: This character's voice in the blips. With 'Global default' it uses the voice picked in the extension settings, with the pitch and speed set here. The voice stays on this device: it is not included in exported cards or backups.
files_hint: One short sound per file. Each letter always uses the same sound of its group, so a word always sounds the same. Files are trimmed to 0.5 s and compressed.
files_empty: No sounds. Without this group, the other one covers its letters.
files_cap: Did not fit: {kb} KB left of {max}.
test_line: "Hi! How are you doing?" *waves and smiles* All set over here.
